catalog.revision_note: 12 swappable VH2 helms on the line's 1.6 mm D-flat peg
catalog.description: Second-generation Vigil helm profile (VH2): a gull-wing wrap visor split by the keel bar, layered crown/temple/nape plates, V-prow respirator with chevron vents, cheek guards with vent slots and aural housings with breather hoses. Twelve variants: VH2-01 Lineguard (line trooper), VH2-02 Tidewall (sealed void/EVA), VH2-03 Lookout (recon, optic stalk), VH2-04 Bastion (heavy, armoured respirator), VH2-05 Marshal (sergeant/warden, blade crest), VH2-06 Mender (medic), VH2-07 Wright (engineer, headlamp and goggles), VH2-08 Plumb (marksman, rangefinder), VH2-09 Kite (pilot/crew), VH2-10 Provost (officer, open face), VH2-11 Lineguard scarred and VH2-12 Bastion breached (battle-damaged). Same 1.6 mm D-flat neck peg as VH-01..10, so every helm fits every Vigil figure.
buildNotes: Defined in tools/vh2.py (VH2 registry, signed-distance sculpt); built by tools/bitspack.py on a 0.05 mm grid, no mesh decimation of the print files.
Visor outlines are polygons wrapped round the skull in arc-length coordinates, so the wings follow the dome instead of being projected flat.
Feature floor: raised details >= 0.5 mm wide, engraved slots >= 0.28 mm wide and 0.25-0.38 mm deep, ribs between slots >= 0.38 mm, antennas >= 0.76 mm diameter.
Display sheets colour the visor glass (faces inside the visor outline and below the frame) for readability; the print files are one solid each.
catalog.limitations: Procedural sculpt at 5.7 mm helm width: the officer's face is a stylised mask (brow, nose, eyes, chin), damage is cut geometry (gouges, pits, chunks), not texture. Printability is a heuristic screen (unified-CAD-MCP), not a test print.
